comments.author: Orakio
comments.body: Someone can give a brief explanation in how to use and what can be produced from it?

wiki:
Use of this item will automatically complete any assigned Aide Production recipe (which usually takes place at 0:00 server time), once per item. Production cannot be carried out if insufficient materials are not stored in Quarters Consumable/Trade Good sections, and/or Private Farm's Warehouse (if the player owns any farm).

Note: The maximum Product Storage (where aide produced items appear) is 10 slots. Equipment items take 1 slot each; stackable items (trade goods/consumables) take 1 slot each and are capped at 5,000 units and 999 units respectively, so be careful to leave room for the assigned items being crafted.
